### 1 — Scene
A chicken-and-avocado salad with leafy greens, broccoli and cucumber. The food on the plate at the left edge is excluded.

### 2 — Vessel
A wide, shallow bowl, estimated **24 cm diameter**.  
Vessel area = 3.14 × 12² ≈ **452 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Visible foods: cooked chicken pieces, avocado, mixed leafy greens, broccoli and cucumber chunks. No distinct oil, dressing or sauce is visible, so none is added.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy
Coverage percentages partition the visible food area without double-counting overlapping ingredients. Volume is the outer envelope; bulk density is the only reduction applied.

| Item | Coverage | Area (cm²) | Height (cm) | Gross volume (ml) | Density (g/ml) | Weight (g) | kcal/100 g | Energy (kcal) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked chicken | 40% | 181 | 1.7 | 308 | 0.95 | 292 | 165 | 482 |
| Avocado | 27% | 122 | 1.8 | 220 | 0.65 | 143 | 160 | 229 |
| Mixed leafy greens | 14% | 63 | 2.0 | 126 | 0.15 | 19 | 20 | 4 |
| Broccoli | 7% | 32 | 2.0 | 64 | 0.60 | 38 | 35 | 13 |
| Cucumber | 4% | 18 | 1.5 | 27 | 0.60 | 16 | 15 | 2 |
| **Total** | **92%** | **416** | | | | **508** | | **730** |

Calculations use **area × height = volume**, then **volume × density = grams**, and **grams × kcal/100 g ÷ 100 = energy**.

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **510 g and 730 kcal** is plausible for this nearly full bowl, with a substantial chicken portion and generous avocado. The visible leaves and vegetable accents receive relatively small weights. Bowl size and pile depth are the main uncertainties.
